# A 4K deck

A 4K slide's photo is downsampled to 2560 px; its edge rules are drawn as vectors.

---

<!-- _class: dark -->

## A dark slide: a 1 px gradient hairline on its top edge

The section paints it as a background image.

---

## A light slide: the spectrum bar on its top edge

The section paints it as a border image.
